name: Ikinari Succubus ~Icha Love Sakusei Life~
original_name: いきなりサキュバス ～いちゃらぶ搾精ライフ～
source:
The protagonist is an ordinary male student. Woken up every morning by Nemu, his childhood friend from next door, he lives a life where nothing ever changes.

One day, he has an erotic dream of being attacked by a succubus. When he wakes up, just like in the dream, Nemu is performing oral sex on him!?

It turns out Nemu comes from a family line of succubi. She has awakened, but she’s still unstable and can’t hold her form unless she gets a steady supply of semen. She says she has nobody else to ask, and pleads with him.

And so their semen-extraction life began.

[Translated from the [url=https://zion.product.co.jp/27_sakyu/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名平凡的男学生，每天早上都在住在隔壁的青梅竹马音梦的叫醒服务中起床，过着一成不变的平静日常。

某天，他做了一个被魅魔夜袭的春梦；谁知睁开眼醒来一看，音梦竟然真的像梦里一样正在埋头含着他的肉棒口交！？

原来音梦竟是魅魔一族的后裔。刚刚觉醒血脉的她状态极不稳定，若不能定期摄取精液便连人形都维持不住。走投无路的她苦苦哀求道，这种事除了他之外再也没有别人可以拜托了。

两人甜蜜缠绵的榨精生活，就此正式拉开序幕。

[译自[url=https://zion.product.co.jp/27_sakyu/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
